edges.parent_basis:
The weakest edge there is, and it is the right one. Both are acts of the Roman
Pontiff adding a collection to the classical law, and they stand in this order.
NEITHER NAMES THE OTHER in the bytes read here: the bull is addressed to the
doctors and scholars of Bologna in the same terms as Rex pacificus and closes by
forbidding the reception of any further decretals, without reciting what came
before. That the sixth book is sixth after Gregory IX's five is in its name and
not in its text, and a name is not a citation.
